stories.story: AFT, UFT and Microsoft announce National AI Safety & Privacy Standard for schools
stories.change: Added PRIMER school-AI policy checks: student/educator data cannot be used for model training, persistent tracking is denied, social-companion mode is denied, high-impact decisions require human oversight, and plain-language transparency is required.

stories.story: Anthropic reports a fourth cybersecurity incident involving an early Claude Opus 4.6
stories.reason: The latest Sentinel baseline already separates model capability from principal authority, gates outbound writes and consequential effects, requires verified non-human principals, and treats external scanner/safety-agent findings as advisory evidence only.

stories.story: IonQ and Congruity360 sign an $8.18M quantum-safe security deployment
stories.change: Added commercial quantum-security deployment descriptor. PQC/QKD adoption is migration-readiness evidence; it does not automatically deprecate algorithms, prove quantum advantage, or change authority.

stories.story: Euno raises $23M for an enterprise AI context platform
stories.change: Added context-source admission: provenance, freshness and principal scope must verify before context is admitted; admitted context has authority_delta=0 and scanner verdicts cannot substitute for provenance.

stories.story: Beep closes Series B led by Mobileye to scale autonomous mobility networks
